messages:
Maya (PM): Figma mockups live — quick decision needed for next sprint. Two main flows: ‘first-tap guidance’ (full-screen carousel modal on first open) vs a persistent ‘side-shelf helper’ that lives in the console UI. Also proposing a templates grid on initial workspace (6 cards) vs a featured-card + ‘view all’. Link: https://figma.redwood/first-run. Which direction for MVP?

Eli (Design): Leaning side-shelf. Less disruptive for users already doing multi-tab work. Concern: discoverability for templates if we bury them. Attached GIF shows shelf opening pattern. Also noticed CTA color needs contrast tweak.

Jonas (Eng): Side-shelf is simpler infra-wise — no route interception or focus trap changes. Carousel modal will need focus management and could block background API calls if we do synchronous checks. Perf note: use inline SVGs instead of raster for the grid images.

Priya (Accessibility): If we do carousel modal we must implement a proper focus trap + aria-live slide announcements. Slides should have role="group" and aria-roledescription="slide". Current CTA hex (#9C7DFF) fails 4.5:1 on light background. Also: ensure close button is reachable by keyboard and not visually hidden.

Sam (Growth): Carousel historically raises activation but can raise churn if too interruptive. Suggest A/B: 10% carousel vs 90% shelf to measure activation and early dropoff. Can set activation metric = "created-project-with-template within 24h."

Maya (PM): Proposal: ship side-shelf by default + one-time spotlight overlay pointing to featured template. Run an A/B with 20% bucket for the full carousel. Action items: Eli — update comps for shelf + spotlight; Jonas — sanity-check routing/mobile collapse; Priya — accessibility checklist; Sam — set up metrics and sample size.

Jonas (Eng): On it. Quick Q: for small viewports do we collapse shelf into a sticky floating dot that opens into a full sheet? That avoids wasting vertical real-estate on mobile. Also: images in grid should lazy-load to avoid jank.

Eli (Design): Yes — collapse to a dot on widths < 720px. I'll add animation frames and reduced-image variants. Microcopy candidates for CTA — which reads better? 
- "Start from template"
- "Use this template"
 Thoughts?

Priya (Accessibility): Short checklist (for the carousel & shelf):
```
- focusable close button
- panel heading for screen readers
- keyboard nav (left/right) for slides
- aria-live region announcing slide changes
- color contrast >= 4.5 for body text and CTA
- all icons have descriptive alt text
- consent checkboxes not pre-checked
```

Sam (Growth): :thumbsup: We'll run the A/B and watch activation + 1-day churn. Also need legal signoff on any telemetry language for templates.

Maya (PM): Thanks — timeline: updated comps from Eli by Thu, eng spike from Jonas Mon, accessibility checklist integrated into PR, Sam to propose sample sizes by EOD Wed. @ConsoleBot please create a design-decision task and tag eng/product/growth.

ConsoleBot: Task created — DD-2745 "First-run guidance: shelf vs carousel" — assigned to Maya, Eli, Jonas, Priya, Sam. Due: 2026-03-27.
